status: Art-direction concept only; not implemented in the application.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: visual art-direction concept for the existing mobile arcade game Atomic Orbital. This is a concept, not a screenshot of implemented software.
Create a highly polished square design board with TWO tall portrait mobile screen designs side by side, straight-on, no phone hardware or tilted device frames. Fill the board with the screen designs and a narrow understated gutter.

Art direction: premium illustrated 2D indie arcade, atmospheric midnight-indigo space, carefully shaded painterly celestial artwork with crisp readable silhouettes. Expressive, a little mischievous, sophisticated composition. Rich blue oceans, leafy green continents, warm ivory lettering, restrained acid-lime and mint accents. Subtle material texture and rim lighting. NOT generic flat vector icons, NOT preschool clip art, NOT emoji, NOT glass dashboard cards, NOT a settings page. Avoid excessive neon bloom, excessive tiny stars, visually noisy scenery and glossy 3D mobile casino aesthetics.

LEFT SCREEN — actual-looking gameplay concept for the Cow Abduction world:
A compact elegant top HUD with score "08" in warm ivory near top center, tiny "NORMAL" text, a thin health indicator, a small pause control. The score is OUTSIDE the Earth. A beautifully illustrated opaque Earth sits at the center of the orbital playfield: immediately recognizable continents, subtle curved cloud shapes, shaded blue ocean, thin cyan atmospheric limb, lit from upper left. No eyes, no face, no white score stripe over the planet. Two precise very faint circular orbit guides around the planet. A small unmistakable metallic UFO with a turquoise canopy and lime rim lights circles the Earth. A small full-body spotted cow floats as a collectible on another point of an orbit, surrounded by a thin pickup halo; a playful readable bovine silhouette, no circular cow-face badge. Three small bright coral-red spherical defense projectiles move away from Earth, with only very short subtle light tails. The gameplay stays clean and legible at phone size. Most space is calm dark negative space.

RIGHT SCREEN — world-selection/shop concept:
A compact top navigation row with a simple back chevron, "WORLDS", and a small tasteful Stardust balance "100" beside a four-point star icon. Lead with world identity instead of explanatory boxes. Small section kicker "01 / 03", a large confident title "COW ABDUCTION". A gorgeous large central world illustration using the SAME shaded Earth, metallic UFO and floating full-body cow, arranged as a lively orbital vignette with a faint tractor-beam suggestion in this SHOP illustration only. No score painted across this hero artwork. Below, one restrained sentence: "Earth has a few objections." Then a prominent beautifully proportioned lime purchase button with exact text "UNLOCK · 150" and a small star icon. Beneath the button, a tasteful narrow three-thumbnail world selector: a minimal atomic Classic thumbnail, the Earth/UFO thumbnail visibly selected, a blue underwater world thumbnail. Small single-line labels "CLASSIC", "ABDUCTION", "DEEP BLUE". No large rectangular product-card grid, no giant balance panel, no paragraphs, no repeated large borders. Clear generous spacing, strong typography hierarchy and intentional alignment.

Use consistent believable mobile UI proportions and legible typography. Show only the text specified. The result should feel like a cohesive desirable arcade game with custom art, not a wireframe. No watermark, no invented branding or slogans.
refinement_prompt:
Edit this Atomic Orbital concept board. Preserve the entire RIGHT screen exactly: its illustration, UI, typography, layout and colors. Preserve the art style and overall palette of the LEFT screen.
Make only these functional corrections to the LEFT gameplay screen:
1. Replace the three hearts at top left with one continuous thin lime health meter. Do not use hearts or discrete lives. Keep the top-center score "08" with "NORMAL" and the pause control.
2. Correct the gameplay geometry to the real game. Keep the orbital arena centered in the left screen. The Earth diameter must be 25% of the LEFT screen width, rather than the current enormous size. Retain rich recognizable continents, clouds and the atmospheric rim at that smaller scale. It must remain an opaque round planet. No score on the Earth.
3. The outer circular orbit diameter is 90% of the LEFT screen width. The inner orbit diameter is 40% of the LEFT screen width. Both are truly circular, concentric with Earth, thin, subdued and clearly visible. This creates a clean navigable gap between the small Earth and the orbits.
4. Put the metallic UFO on the outer orbit, diameter about 6% of LEFT screen width. Put the full-body spotted cow collectible on the inner orbit, diameter about 8% of LEFT screen width, in a subtle collection halo. Red spherical defense projectiles are each about 3% of LEFT screen width, placed between the planet and outer orbit. Keep any tails extremely short.
5. Calm the LEFT screen's background within the actual orbital arena: much darker and quieter with very faint star points. Preserve some tasteful painted space detail at the far top/bottom edges. No large rocks or scenery obscuring the playable arena.
Keep all right-screen content unchanged. These are gameplay readability and geometry corrections, not a new visual direction. No added copy, labels, watermarks or device frames.
implementation_notes: Explore richer Earth/UFO/cow artwork and a focused world selector rather than product-card grid.
Score is separated from the core to avoid the earlier pale stripe across the artwork.
Preserve actual game hitboxes, world dimensions, health rules and simulation when implementing.
Generated screen proportions and UI are illustrative, not a pixel-accurate implementation specification.
No runtime code, currency behavior or app builds changed in this concept pass.
